desc: Bugles are a unique, funnel shaped crispy corn snack coated in chili cheese flavoring for snacking satisfaction. Individually packaged and available in bulk, 6 - 3 oz bags, best suited for retail operations.
features:
• A unique snacking experience of crispy corn triangles doused in chili cheese flavoring.  
  • Available in bulk, 6 - 3 oz bags, and easily peggable in c-store salty sets.  
  • Recommended for convenience stores as this size and format is great for the on-the-go patron.  
  • Bugles are a light and healthier alternative to Potato Chips as they are made with 0 trans fat and no cholesterol.
ingredients:
Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Coconut Oil and/or Palm Kernel Oil, Maltodextrin, Sugar, Salt. Contains 2 % or less of: Spice, Monosodium Glutamate, Monoglycerides, Buttermilk Powder, Baking Soda, Tomato Powder, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Whey, Palm Oil, Citric Acid, Natural And Artificial Flavor, Reduced Lactose Whey, Cheddar Cheese (cultured milk, salt, enzymes), Disodium Inosinate, Disodium Guanylate, Paprika Extract, Disodium Phosphate. Freshness Preserved by BHT.

CONTAINS MILK; MAY CONTAIN WHEAT INGREDIENTS.
